structural_change: S81-NATIVE3 (10-17): m_v/um_v/y_v no longer reach logic from the pins (pin flops; 0 added cycles). Previous: S81-TILES2 10-17 g3 (one-macro sub-beat ring): the 4-macro 1024-b bank (AQ_XMEM=1) failed gate 2 at its W/E pin walls (trial GRT overflow 502: wd_in-hi + 1,024 tied w_mask pins on the E faces, the wd-hi nets detouring round a 164-um M1-M4 wall since M5 is vertical). AQ_XMEM=2 rebuilds aq12's x wait line from the 256-b sub-beat stream: ONE 128x256 macro written every cycle with sd_, read 11 rows behind, replayed with a 3-b x 12 control line into a 1024-b re-assembly register (xr = blk delayed 12 = the flop line's xg every cycle; bit-exact bench + mutant). 1 macro at (43.2, 43.2) R0, rd/wd-lo face W toward the main std-cell band, back face (117 wd-hi + 256 ties) toward a 34.8-um E strip; outline 172.8 x 129.6 (1.33:1, was 162 x 231.12); clk on N beside the band. S81-TILES3 10-17 (coordinator 0co review): (a) the quantiser is the vq-only fork ot_s81sl_aq12x (xd port, no u_x line); rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_aq12.sv is byte-identical with main again. (b) the 128x256 macro moves to the SE corner (55.3, 23.8) R0, 20-um channels to the E pin face and the S core edge (S carries no pins: fault moves to N), so the cells form ONE L-shaped band (W column 53 um wide + N band 84.8-149 full width) instead of a ring around a central macro; outline 172.8 x 151.2 so the E-face xf pins (y 86.4-146.9, 4.9/um) sit beside the N band, above the macro channel. (c) W face: y 6.5-73.4 (4.2/um, from vn), u 73.4-144.7 (4.0/um, from vs); E face: xf to the ring-stop relay (u_up). S81-TILES5 10-17 (coordinator 0co ~17:55 review: CHANGES): the 4 'S-face pins' of gate 90be2e2fe were the VSS M5 PG stripes (pin_demand nearest-edge tie on full-height stripes), not signal pins: S carries no signal pin. The macro now sits ON the S core edge (55.296, 2.16) R0 -- its S face is bare (no pin within 200 nm) and the tile S face is pin-free, so ref_tile.py waives the 20-um core-edge channel there (bare_face); E keeps the 20.5-um pin-face channel (the macro's E face carries wd-hi / w_mask / cr / rr pins). No std-cell strip under the macro: ONE L band (W column x 2.2-44.5 beside the macro + N band y 54-127.4 full width). Outline shrinks 172.8 x 151.2 -> 172.8 x 129.6 (util 41% -> ~49%). Pins: W y 12.96-73.44 (60.5 um, 4.2/um: vn's E face re-pins to this span), u 79.92-123.12 (5.9/um); E xf 64.8-123.1 (5.1/um, beside the N band above the macro's E channel); N unchanged.
